Understanding Modern Web Applications

Modern web development has evolved significantly over the past decade.

Developers now have access to native browser primitives such as custom highlights and clipboard APIs.

Simplicity is prerequisite for reliability.

Key Architectural Advantages

  • Zero runtime dependency footprint
  • Native CSS system color adaptation
  • Predictable and synchronous state management
function selectBlock(event: MouseEvent) {
  return findLevels(event.target);
}

These principles allow applications to run reliably without introducing security vulnerabilities.
